native_mechanisms: The stone never resets between marks: one running state carried across the whole pile, no re-initialisation per mark.

Each mark's weight is pressed into the already-turned state rather than onto a clean face, so earlier marks bend how later marks land (strictly order-dependent, serial dependency chain with amplifying differences).
Only the final seated reading leaves the desk: all intermediate turns and residue are discarded, the wide state collapsed to one output number.
core_technique: Sponge-style absorb of 32-byte blocks XORed into a single 256-bit ARX state (add + cross-lane permute/shuffle + rotate, deliberately one serial chain rather than independent lanes), four blind permutation rounds, then truncation to 64 bits through a Murmur-style fmix finaliser.
